correctness.rationale: Mean final infected size under uniform seed and independent path bonds equals n^-1 times sum of squared open-component sizes, hence n E X=n+2 sum over unordered vertex pairs of the product of path open probabilities. Exact two-factor expansion with r=p-q yields K_n−2r(D_i+D_j)+2r^2 A_i p^(j-i-1) A_(n-j). Independently expanded all ten P6 pair energies symbolically and recovered the table of positive differences from (2,4) except the adjacent class -2(p-q)[(1+p)q−p]. This proves the unique separated optimum for q<p/(1+p), three-way tie at equality, and two adjacent optima above. For each n>=6, strict discrete convexity of block cost g_p at q=0 and strict central-edge D_i+D_j superiority as r→0, with finite-set continuity, establish nonadjacent strong and adjacent weak intervention regimes for all p∈(0,1].

value.rationale: Two equally weakened contact links on a path are a canonical small network-interdiction design. An exact P6 minimum-size separated-to-adjacent switch and the all-length opposite limiting regimes demonstrate a substantive nonmonotone placement phenomenon rather than a trivial zero-transmission cut.

limitations: Not a correlated SIR model, n>6 intermediate q optima are not fully classified, and intervention efficacy is identical on precisely two edges.
